QuestInfo.name: [Neo Tokyo] Distorted Hearts and Minds
QuestInfo.0: #o9601834# wanted to be the life-support system for #p9401523#, who fell into a coma because of environmental pollution. #p9401522# theorizes that #o9601834# malfunctioned while trying to save her, and decided to destroy the whole world as a way of cleansing it. You returned to #p9401533# and told her all this.
QuestInfo.1: When the link between a soul and a body is weak, those who have mastered reincarnation can temporarily possess that body. It looks like that's what #o9601836# did; he seized the body of the comatose #p9120030# and impersonated her to manipulate #o9601834#.
